data.name: Kamta
data.gender_notes: Kamta is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Sanskrit, Kamta means 'desire' or 'love'. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'kama', which represents pleasure, desire, or love. In Hindu mythology, Kamadeva is the god of desire and love, and the name Kamta is associated with the divine energy of love and passion. The name Kamta carries the meaning “Desire, Love” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Kamta usually hope their child will grow to embody desire, love and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name filled with the divine energy of love and passion.
data.etymology: Kamta belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Desire, Love.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kamta total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

The name is also reflective of the Indian belief in the power of love and desire, which is believed to transcend mundane existence and uplift one's soul.
